name: DeepWiki
description: Read the generated wiki of any public GitHub repository and ask questions about its code through DeepWiki's hosted MCP server, by Cognition. No sign-in; public repositories only.
examples: Use DeepWiki to explain how facebook/react schedules updates, and which files I should read first.
Ask DeepWiki where vercel/next.js handles middleware matching.
Show me the wiki outline for modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk and summarize the transport section.

zh-CN.name: DeepWiki
zh-CN.description: 通过 Cognition 的 DeepWiki 官方托管 MCP 服务，阅读任意公开 GitHub 仓库自动生成的 Wiki，并就它的代码提问。无需登录；只覆盖公开仓库。
examples: 用 DeepWiki 解释 facebook/react 是怎么调度更新的，以及我应该先读哪些文件。
问问 DeepWiki：vercel/next.js 在哪里处理中间件的匹配？
列出 modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk 的 Wiki 目录，并概括传输层那一节。
